items.source: This package provides a ChatModel implementation that enables interaction with Claude models through Anthropic's Messages API. The integration supports both synchronous and streaming conversations, tool/function calling, and full observability through Micrometer.
items.translation: 该包提供了一个ChatModel实现，支持通过 Anthropic 的消息 API 与 Claude 模型进行交互。此集成同时支持同步和流式对话、工具/函数调用，并通过 Micrometer 提供完整的可观测性。

items.source:
AnthropicChatModel chatModel = new AnthropicChatModel(
    AnthropicChatOptions.builder()
        .model("claude-sonnet-4-20250514")
        .maxTokens(1024)
        .build());

ChatResponse response = chatModel.call(new Prompt("Hello, Claude!"));
